submission.justification: Absorber-F2 with 4 mm plate thickness is the optimal choice for the forward electromagnetic calorimeter. This configuration achieves an energy resolution of 3.166% at 100 GeV, which is the best performance among all tested configurations. This provides a comfortable 1.334 percentage point margin below the 4.5% requirement, ensuring robust operation even with potential systematic uncertainties. The material meets all dose rate constraints for hands-on maintenance. Among the two materials that meet the resolution requirement (F2 and F3), F2 delivers superior performance with 3.166% compared to F3's 4.005% at their respective optimal thicknesses. F1 did not meet the resolution requirement at any tested thickness within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is one of the three candidate materials (F1, F2, F3) specified in the project documentation.

requirements.requirement: The energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 with 4 mm plates achieves 3.166% energy resolution at 100 GeV, well below the 4.5% maximum requirement.

requirements.requirement: The residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h
requirements.evidence: F2_meets_dose_constraint = 1 indicates that Absorber-F2 satisfies the dose rate constraint for hands-on maintenance.
The recommended plate thickness of 4 mm falls within the specified range of 2-10 mm.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F2 at 4 mm thickness achieves 3.166% resolution, which is the best among all tested configurations: F2_best_resolution = 3.166 is superior to F3_best_resolution = 4.005 and all F1 configurations.
